cohort: The study included 378 women (126 with preeclampsia, 126 with preeclampsia with severe features, and 126 with healthy normotensive pregnancies) who delivered at a large tertiary referral hospital between 2018 and 2022.
finding: High levels of SII, PIV, and SIRI measured from first trimester complete blood count were associated with an increased risk of future preeclampsia and preeclampsia with severe features, suggesting their potential use as early screening markers.
